title: UK taxpayer funds held in offshore tax havens top £1tn, latest HMRC data shows
summary_full: Figures show recent 10% rise in total held in financial centres such as Jersey and Panama raising fears over cost to public purseThe amount of money UK taxpayers hold in offshore accounts in tax havens has exceeded £1tn for the first time, raising concerns about potential losses to the public purse.HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) data, obtained by the TaxWatch thinktank through freedom of information requests, shows between 2022 and 2024 the value of balances held offshore in tax havens increased by 10%. These were the latest available figures. Continue reading...
